# Preserve name namespaces at titlebar markup and style boundaries

The checked titlebar uses dash-separated shared classes such as titlebar-buttonbox-container, dash-separated IDs such as titlebar-title-label, and dash-separated messenger-window-* Fluent IDs. The unified toolbar keeps camelCase IDs such as unifiedToolbarContainer. Recommend following the local namespace when extending these controls rather than renaming older IDs to one global form. This is a scoped observed mapping, with no claim of review-approved project policy. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/base/content.
